options.query: select ma_ttct, ten_ttct%l from dmttct where ma_ct = '@@voucherCode' and status = 1 order by stt

query.text: declare @strKey nvarchar(3000) set @strKey =' ma_ct = ''PF1''' exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmnv c on a.ma_nv= c.ma_nv left join dmpb e on a.ma_pb = e.ma_pb left join dmbp f on a.ma_bp = f.ma_bp and a.ma_pb = f.ma_pb left join dmhmdx g on a.ma_hmdx = g.ma_hmdx left join dmloaidx h on a.ma_loaidx = h.ma_loaidx','b.ma_unit, c.ten_nv, e.ten_pb, f.ten_bp, g.ten_hmdx, h.ten_loaidx', '@@key', '', @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId drop table #unitright

finding.text: declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @strDetailKey nvarchar(3000); set @strDetailKey = '' set @strKey = 'ngay_ct between ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct1, 112) + ''' and ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct2, 112) + ''' and ' + @strFinding set @strKey = @strKey +' and ma_ct = ''PF1''' exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmnv c on a.ma_nv= c.ma_nv left join dmpb e on a.ma_pb = e.ma_pb left join dmbp f on a.ma_bp = f.ma_bp and a.ma_pb = f.ma_pb left join dmhmdx g on a.ma_hmdx = g.ma_hmdx left join dmloaidx h on a.ma_loaidx = h.ma_loaidx','b.ma_unit, c.ten_nv , e.ten_pb, f.ten_bp, g.ten_hmdx, h.ten_loaidx', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId drop table #unitright
